Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using specially crafted CSV files exploiting Microsoft Excel's Dynamic Data Exchange (DDE) feature to execute PowerShell commands that download and execute malware DLLs
Use of WMIC.exe via DDE to launch PowerShell scripts that download and execute malicious DLLs
Impacted Systems: Windows devices in corporate and government networks
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with malicious CSV attachments exploiting Excel DDE feature
Indicators of Compromise: PowerShell command downloading picture.jpg saved as C:\Users\Public\87764675478.dll
Execution of rundll32.exe to run the DLL
WMIC.exe calls embedded in CSV file columns
